story: My DNS queries are being intercepted and altered in-flight
text: As others have mentioned this seems entirely expected based on how Google uses DNS for load balancing and serving your query from a datacenter as close to you as possible. If you want to see some details of how it works have a look at [VIDEO] . Disclaimer: I work for Google. I speak for myself etc. blah.

story: What happens when you type Google.com into your browser's address box
text: Disclaimer: not representing anybody, my opinion not anybody else's. I work at Google, and my team looks after this. Here: [VIDEO] I can't tell you anything that's not in that video.

I've only ever found two things publicly available on this. The patent related to DNS GSLB [LINK] and the video by Simon Newton which describes the global footprint and some of the services [VIDEO] . Most of what I know about GSLB is from my time working at Google.
